review.scale: 0 unusable, 5 functional with substantial friction, 7 good with noticeable limits, 10 exceptional observed mobile experience. Holistic judgment, not an arithmetic average or a win/loss grade.

reasons.overallMobile: Coherent, completable mission with effective touch assists, clear progress and atmospheric presentation. Dark targets, control density, occasional wall-facing route motion and divided combat/phase attention create noticeable friction. Two paused synthetic attempts only.
reasons.controls: Tap aim, TURN, held FIRE and route were effective. Brief manual MOVE plus FIRE drag and separate scene drag visibly responded. Large buttons are accessible in the emulated viewport, but crowd the lower scene. Sustained manual mastery and AIM remain unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, coil phases and uplink form a clear sequence with directional threats and shield recovery. Assisted travel carried much of the mission and the short final upload resolved with little defensive input. Continuous challenge, enjoyment and content beyond these attempts are unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Distinct cyan/amber industrial rain atmosphere, cohesive title/results typography, readable weapon animation and restrained progress overlays. Scene is often very dark. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Concise handbook, changing route/approach labels, saved confirmations, paused planning map and fresh-start action worked. Some route turns temporarily face walls; multiple simultaneous instructions and warnings compete.
reasons.readability: High-contrast HUD health/ammo and numbered OFF states are clear at 390x844. Small scene labels, dark distant targets, and stacked banners reduce scanning clarity.
